proposal.summary: Improper Authentication vulnerability in ABB Symphony Plus S+ Operations affects versions from 2.X through 2.1 SP2, 2.2, and from 3.X through 3.3 SP1, 3.3 SP2.
proposal.affected_product: ABB Symphony Plus S+ Operations: from 2.X through 2.1 SP2, 2.2, from 3.X through 3.3 SP1, 3.3 SP2.

C.quote: This issue allows unauthorized access to the system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the authentication mechanisms in the affected versions and apply necessary patches or updates.

evidence_quotes.quote: This issue allows unauthorized access to the system.
